spending_entity: Ministério da Economia Digital (vote 01.03.02) principally; the programme is cross-vote
programme: CABO VERDE PLATAFORMA DIGITAL E DA INOVAÇÃO
line_name: CABO VERDE PLATAFORMA DIGITAL E DA INOVAÇÃO
purpose: CABO VERDE PLATAFORMA DIGITAL E DA INOVAÇÃO - programme of the *Economia* pillar. The volume prints the programme title and its financing split and no narrative.
scope_basis: Explicit programme title - the state's own digital platform and innovation programme. Single-purpose by title; the whole domestic share is digital.
amount_scale: escudos (units). The FY2025 mapas print commas as the thousands separator where FY2024 printed full stops and the Conta Provisória prints spaces - parse per table. Proved by cross-footing Tesouro 595,668,565 + OFN 2,000,000 + Donativo 37,000,000 + Empréstimo 216,835,642 = Total 851,504,207, and by the mapa's grand total 97,911,339,875.
doc_locator: Lei n.º 45/X/2024, BO I Serie n.º 125 Suplemento de 30-12-2024, `Mapa VII` (BO p.98); outturn at `Mapas_Contas_4o_Trim_2025_Site.xlsx`, sheet `Mapa VII_ Despesas por Programa`, row 16
notes: `Mapa VII - Despesa por Programa e Tipo de Financiamento` is the only table in the Cabo Verdean budget that states a digital line's **purpose** and its **financing origin** together. Columns: `Tesouro | OFN (Outras Fontes Nacionais) | FCP AAL (Fundo de Contravalor / Ajuda Alimentar) | Donativo | Empréstimos | Total`. **`Tesouro + OFN` is the domestic-state share and is what this record carries**; `Donativo` and `Empréstimos` are external and are excluded by the origin gate. · Why the programme axis and not the ministry vote.** `Mapa III` publishes the vote only as ministry x programme *type* (Investimento / Finalístico / Gestão e Apoio Administrativo). `Mapa VII` is the finest published grain at which a line's stated purpose is digital, and the only one that prints the origin split. Recording both axes would double-count the same escudos, so the organic figures are carried here as context. · Cabo Verde passed no rectificative budget for 2025, and that is the country's normal mechanism, not an omission.** The revised stage here is the `Orçamento Reprogramado` column of the fourth-quarter provisional account, which is the accumulated result of twelve monthly `Alterações Orçamentais` virement files. State-wide the ORP exceeds the appropriation by 11.5% (97,911,339,793 -> 109,150,760,055) with no statute behind it. The FY2026 volume confirms this rather than superseding it: its comparator column for 2025 is labelled `OE` and `Estimativa`, and its 168-page narrative contains no occurrence of `retificativ`, `rectificativ` or `revisto`. · The two axes tell opposite stories and both are true.** On the organic axis the digital ministry looks like a failure: `01.03.02 GOV - Ministério Da Economia Digital` **OI CVE 369,781,930** (Investimento **0** + Finalístico 342,498,843 + Apoio 27,283,087) -> **ORP 1,472,731,889** (661,584,487 + 783,864,315 + 27,283,087) -> **EXE 558,272,390** (8,446,342 + 524,832,801 + 24,993,247) = **37.9% of ORP**, against a state-wide 79.1%, with **investment executed at 1.3%**. On the programme axis the state's own digital money was spent almost in full - 99.3% of what was voted. **The gap is the external money**: what did not move in FY2025 was the CVE 1.37bn of loan finance reprogrammed into the digital ministry, not the escudos the Assembly voted. Both figures are recorded here and neither should be quoted without the other. · The digital vote was cut 73.4% and its capital line appropriated at a printed zero** - CVE 1,390,965,632 in FY2024 to CVE 369,781,930 in FY2025, against a total state expenditure that rose 13.9% from 85,948,752,206 to 97,911,339,875. **The programme's domestic share went the other way**, from CVE 568,184,541 to CVE 597,668,565, +5.2%. The vote fell; the state's own digital spending did not. · Then the capital was re-created in-year and still not spent.** FY2024: CVE 553,090,000 of investment appropriated, a printed literal zero executed. FY2025: zero appropriated, **CVE 661,584,487 created by virement** - almost exactly the previous year's unspent capital - and CVE 8,446,342 executed, 1.3%. The reprogrammed totals for the two years are near-identical (1,483,485,681 and 1,472,731,889). The money is re-created annually and annually not spent. · The organic code for the state-modernisation ministry moved from `01.03.10` (FY2024) to `01.03.11` (FY2025).** Codes are the cross-year join key in this dataset and this one is not stable; a series built on the code alone would break here. · `amount_usd` left blank.** No named fiscal-year-average CVE/USD rate is held; the escudo is pegged to the euro (110.265 CVE/EUR), so a dollar figure would be a two-step conversion the wiki cannot date to a named source.

notes: `is_transfer: true`.** The same escudos sit in the buying ministries' votes, which this pass records on the programme axis. · NOSi's money is now four times the whole digital vote, up from 73% a year earlier.** Forecast total revenue rose 46% (1,016,802 -> 1,486,249 mCVE) in the same year the `Ministério da Economia Digital` vote fell 73.4% (CVE 1,390,965,632 -> 369,781,930). **The state's digital money has migrated out of the appropriation and into a state enterprise's trading account.** Components (mCVE): Housing 27,432; IaaS 67,326; PaaS 9,431; SaaS 17,085; Comunicação 13,250; Acessórios 3,112; Bundled 68,620; **Protocolos 333,345 (unchanged)**; Outros 16,788; Consultoria/Formação/Estágio 23,226; Certificados Digitais 1,082; **Projetos 671,089 (+213%)**; **Projetos Financiados 234,465 (-13%)**. · `Projetos Financiados` CVE 234,465,000 is donor money and is excluded** by the origin gate; the plan names no financier, so no `non-state` record is built from it. · No outturn for FY2025.** *(Corrected 2026-08-04, superseding the note carried here that the `Relatório e Contas` series runs 2016–2023 and stops.)* The series runs **2016–2024** — the 2024 accounts are posted and are now held as 2024-12-31-nosi-relatorio-de-gestao-e-contas-2024. **No 2025 volume is posted (as of 2026-08-04)**, so this FY2025 forecast still cannot be tested against outturn.
